notes: Routes decoded from photographed holograms unless noted; not all returned issuer records have been independently matched.
Artifacts 57 and 313 show the same Fanatics number RG13313204; association preserved for owner review.
Artifact 30: hologram number transcribed from retained COA, 144115.
Artifacts 77 and 712 currently link to clearly identified hologram photographs, not issuer records.
No external URL is guaranteed permanent. Do not invent unsupported query parameters.
Corrected after live route checks: 027 = Real Sports (prefilled codes plus CAPTCHA); 028 = Seattle Kraken (manual codes); 02M = NHL licensing QR to NHL Shop, excluded as an authentication link.
Bruins links use the observed HTTPS authenticator record URL with both codes, avoiding an intermediate QR redirect.
